question.text: Incorrect statement about carbon monoxide is: -

options.text: It is highly soluble in water
It burns in oxygen to produce considerable amount of heat
It is toxic having bond order <math><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math>
It is found in coal gas, water gas and produces gas

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> is sparingly soluble in water
